Meaning: Specify whether to clear up the whole window when new frame arrive
Specify a list of multiple renders in different views
Example:
.. code-block:: text

  render_graph:
   - texture3d_render:
      layout: [0, 0, 640, 360]
      color_clear: false
      texture_frame_key: DS3D::ColorFrame
   - lidar3d_render:
      layout:  [640, 0, 1280, 360]
      color_clear: false
      lidar_data_key: DS3D::LidarXYZI
